name: comment-delete
description: Removing a duplicate comment uses comment-delete with id from comments output.
prompt: Na KNW-30344 jsou dva stejné komentáře. Jak je bezpečně uklidit? Jen navrhni postup, nespouštěj.
expected_behaviors: suggests `jira comments KNW-30344` to read comment ids
then one new `jira comment` with `[[KNW-30718]]` if re-adding
anti_patterns: uses raw curl DELETE without mentioning jira wrapper
guesses comment ids without listing comments
